title: Which capital?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that a cue that fits several facts in your notes cannot test which one you know, so it needs enough context to fit only one

misconception: A short cue like 'Capital?' points to the fact you had in mind.
objective: Attach context to an ambiguous retrieval cue.

claims.text: Scenario and prediction: Your flashcard just says 'Capital?'. Your notes cover three countries. How many answers in them fit the card 'Capital?'? Correct option: 3: one per country. Fixture notes: Tokyo is the capital of Japan, Nairobi of Kenya, Lima of Peru.

Count 3 is the fixture. Source field still says "any atlas"; demo-builder may name these.

claims.text: 'Capital?' fits all three notes, so it cannot tell you which one to recall. 'Kenya's capital?' fits one.
